notes.title: Update 1.2 Review | Technical issues with the update event
notes.notes:
Hey all! Following our initial 1.2 update release, we realized that many of you had not seen the update, due to a technical issue, so we wanted to reach out again, now that the technical issue on steam was resolved

So if you have already seen the update, please feel free to ignore this, and thank you for the continued interest :)

Additionally, after some feedback, we found the initial price to be a bit too high, so we have adjusted it based on the players' request.

The 1.2 update included:

New Environments:

notes.title: Update Preview (Coming Aug 15th 2021)
notes.notes:
Hey all!
Please meet DoT!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40738776/33b52289fa05edf175a7a3621696f4ee19505704.png

DoT is a machine-learning powered robot, who will be joining us in the next upcoming update.
He will bring with him:


 More Environments for you to play around in!
 Better Audio!
 Better support for all SteamVR Headsets!
 Hopefully 1 more song too... fingers crossed ;) art takes time


We look forward to seeing you around.
Thanks for joining us this early in our development process.

Greetings from the JTB squad! :)
